subject: general
question: Identify the correct definition of Long Run Marginal Cost (LRMC) from the following.

options.text: The change in total expense per unit of change in input.
The change in average expense per unit of change in output.
The change in total cost per unit of change in output.
The change in marginal cost per unit of change in input.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The change in total cost per unit of change in output**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Long Run Marginal Cost (LRMC) represents the extra cost incurred by a firm to produce one additional unit of output in the long run. Unlike the short run where some inputs are fixed, the long run allows a firm to adjust all its inputs (labor, capital, technology) to achieve optimal production levels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Derived from Long Run Total Cost (LRTC):** LRMC is the slope of the LRTC curve at any given level of output.
 
• **Relationship with Long Run Average Cost (LRAC):**
 
 
• When LRMC is below LRAC, LRAC is falling.
 
• When LRMC is above LRAC, LRAC is rising.
 
• When LRMC intersects LRAC, LRAC is at its minimum point.
 
 
 
• **Reflects Returns to Scale:** LRMC is closely linked to returns to scale.
 
• **Increasing Returns to Scale: **If output more than doubles when inputs double, LRMC is falling.
 
• **Constant Returns to Scale:** If output doubles when inputs double, LRMC is constant.
 
• **Decreasing Returns to Scale: **If output less than doubles when inputs double, LRMC is rising.
 
• **Production Decisions:** Firms use LRMC to determine the optimal level of output to maximize profits. They compare LRMC to the long-run marginal revenue (LRMR) and produce where LRMC equals LRMR.
 
• **Long-Run Planning:** LRMC helps firms make long-term decisions about plant size, technology adoption, and resource allocation.
 
• **Understanding Industry Structure:** The shape of the LRMC curve can provide insights into the competitive structure of an industry.
